profile.headline: A software engineer with experience in developing high performing software in various scales: from resource-constrained embedded systems, to clusters of servers.
profile.summary: Accomplished software engineer with extensive experience in developing and leading software solutions for critical and high-stakes environments. Proficient in multiple programming languages, including Rust, C/C++, Python, and Go, with a strong background in signal processing, distributed systems, and backend development. Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing microservices, creating high-performance applications, and transitioning traditional systems to more reliable, modern technologies. Adept at leveraging tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Kafka to enhance system performance and reliability. Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams and deliver innovative solutions that meet organizational needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Monica, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Implementation of the Hulu and Disney+ client for set-top boxes in Rust targeting WebAssembly runtimes

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Embedded Flight Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed services in C for NASA’s IMAP mission to interface with spacecraft sensors, collecting telemetry and sending commands using the SpaceWire standard.
- Contributed to an open-source C library for the RFC-9172 standard, set to be the protocol's standard
implementation across NASA.
- Led a proposal to transition spacecraft software services from C to Rust, leveraging Rust’s memory safety and compile-time bug detection to enhance reliability.
positions.insights: Software Development, System Performance and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Lead
positions.description:
- Led the software and systems engineering efforts using a microservices-based approach to create a distributed platform for orchestrating multiple applications on several compute nodes.
- Designed event-based API's to decouple service logic using Google’s Protocol Buffers (protobuf).
- Utilized Kafka as the central message broker between services and Kubernetes for deploying core services.
positions.insights: Software Development, System Performance and +11 skills

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a Python service to manage containerized applications using Docker SDK, with high-performance communication via gRPC and telemetry collection using ZeroMQ. Later re-wrote the service in Go to overcome Python's concurrency limitations.
- Created a C++ application for radio control based on channel state, reading FPGA measurements via DMA, timestamping and storing metrics in SQLite, and making REST API calls for radio configuration based on analysis.

positions.title: Digital Signal Processing Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the software team implement a software defined radio based transceiver using a custom direct sequence spread-spectrum waveform based on 802.14 (Zigbee). I developed the basic algorithms used to receive and decode packets from the RF data in real time.

Concurrent to the previous work, I created simulations in Matlab to generate a probability density function (PDF) that represents the potential interference caused by mobile phones on a specific band. I sped up the analysis by bypassing calculations of convolutions and using an approximation of the sum of lognormal distributions. This reduced the execution time of the simulation from hours to minutes.

projects.title: Visualization of a Game Theory Based Algorithm for Communications between Spacecraft
projects.description:
This project implements a visualization for opportunistic routing in space scenarios based on game theory concepts. Written in Rust to compile to WebAssembly. Used Tauri to make it a desktop application.

The project is based on the theory presented by Kassan et al on: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1084804518302911?via%3Dihub

projects.title: RP2040-FreeRTOS BNO055 Sensor Application
projects.description:
This repo contains my base project for a FreeRTOS application to be ran on the Raspberry Pi RP2040 microcontroller. This was developed using a Adafruit Feather RP2040.

The application connects using the default I2C interface to a BNO055 sensor and extracts pitch, yaw, and roll from it and prints it to stdio. Stdio is configured to be over UART using interface UART0 or USB.

Based on the work done by smittytone, details in: https://blog.smittytone.net/2022/02/24/how-to-use-freertos-with-the-raspberry-pi-pico/
